analysis.summaryJa: 場所・状況のwhere、時のwhen、理由のwhyと、改まったin whichなどの前置詞＋whichを区別する。
grammarPoints: whereは場所や状況内で起きる完全文を導く。
whenはday・year・periodなど時を受ける。
whyはreasonの内容を示し、省略もできる。
whereは文脈によりin which、under whichなどに言い換えられる。
visualEvidence: 地図ピン・時計・理由の道が、それぞれwhere・when・whyの入口へつながる。
whereからin whichへ変換する正式表現のパネルがある。
commonTraps: 場所名詞を見ただけでwhereを選び、節内の欠落を確認しない。
where節内にthere、when節内にthenを重ねる。
why節を疑問文語順にする。

questions.prompt: The committee reached a stage ------- additional testing was unavoidable.

choices.C: where
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 委員会は追加試験が避けられない段階に達しました。
questions.explanationJa: stage内の状況を表す完全な節をwhereが導きます。

questions.prompt: Please confirm the date ------- the revised policy will take effect.

choices.C: why
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 改訂方針が発効する日を確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: dateという時点で起きる事柄なのでwhenです。

questions.prompt: The main reason ------- the shipment was delayed was a customs inspection.

choices.C: which
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: 配送が遅れた主な理由は税関検査でした。
questions.explanationJa: the reasonの内容を示す節にはwhyが自然です。

questions.prompt: We need a secure room ------- confidential records can be reviewed.

choices.C: when
choices.D: why

questions.translationJa: 機密記録を確認できる安全な部屋が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: reviewedの場所が欠けるためwhereを使います。

questions.prompt: That was the month ------- our online sales first exceeded store sales.

choices.C: why
choices.D: whose

questions.translationJa: その月にオンライン売上が初めて店頭売上を上回りました。
questions.explanationJa: monthという時を説明するためwhenです。

questions.prompt: The contract describes the circumstances ------- either party may cancel the service.

choices.C: in which
choices.D: from which

questions.translationJa: 契約書には、いずれかの当事者がサービスを解約できる状況が記されています。
questions.explanationJa: circumstancesの中で、という改まった表現はin whichです。

questions.prompt: No one explained the reason ------- the reservation had been removed.

choices.C: where
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 予約が削除された理由を誰も説明しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: reasonの内容を示すためwhyを置きます。

questions.prompt: The period ------- demand is highest usually begins in November.

choices.C: whom
choices.D: when

questions.translationJa: 需要が最も高くなる期間は通常11月に始まります。
questions.explanationJa: periodという時の範囲をwhenが受けます。

questions.prompt: The audit revealed several cases ------- approval had been recorded incorrectly.

choices.C: where
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 監査で、承認が誤って記録された事例が複数判明しました。
questions.explanationJa: caseを『その事例では』と状況化するwhereです。

questions.prompt: The laboratory has a sealed cabinet ------- the samples are kept overnight.

choices.C: to which
choices.D: by which

questions.translationJa: 研究室には試料を一晩保管する密閉棚があります。
questions.explanationJa: cabinet内で保管することを形式的にin whichで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a difficult situation.

choices.A: We faced a situation when every available option carried a risk.
choices.B: We faced a situation where every available option carried a risk.
choices.C: We faced a situation where every available option carried a risk there.
choices.D: We faced a situation which every available option carried a risk.

questions.translationJa: 利用できる全選択肢にリスクがある状況に直面しました。
questions.explanationJa: 状況内を表し、後続節が完全文なのでwhereが正解です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a launch date.

choices.A: I remember the day where the new platform went live.
choices.B: I remember the day when the new platform went live then.
choices.C: I remember the day why the new platform went live.
choices.D: I remember the day when the new platform went live.

questions.translationJa: 新しいプラットフォームが稼働した日を覚えています。
questions.explanationJa: dayという時点をwhenが説明し、thenは不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a complaint.

choices.A: The reason why the client complained was the missing invoice.
choices.B: The reason where the client complained was the missing invoice.
choices.C: The reason why did the client complain was the missing invoice.
choices.D: The reason which the client complained was the missing invoice.

questions.translationJa: 顧客が苦情を述べた理由は請求書の欠落でした。
questions.explanationJa: reason whyの後ろは平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about record storage.

choices.A: This is the archive in where the original contracts are stored.
choices.B: This is the archive which the original contracts are stored.
choices.C: This is the archive in which the original contracts are stored.
choices.D: This is the archive in which the original contracts are stored there.

questions.translationJa: ここが原本契約書を保管する資料室です。
questions.explanationJa: in whichはwhereの改まった言い方で、thereを重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a sales cycle.

choices.A: There are weeks where customer inquiries double.
choices.B: There are weeks when customer inquiries double.
choices.C: There are weeks when customer inquiries double then.
choices.D: There are weeks why customer inquiries double.

questions.translationJa: 顧客からの問い合わせが倍増する週があります。
questions.explanationJa: weeksという時の範囲をwhenが受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a workplace process.

choices.A: We need a process where every request is logged automatically.
choices.B: We need a process when every request is logged automatically.
choices.C: We need a process where every request is logged automatically there.
choices.D: We need a process which every request is logged automatically.

questions.translationJa: すべての依頼が自動記録される仕組みが必要です。
questions.explanationJa: processを状況として説明するwhereが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a cancellation.

choices.A: The reason why was the workshop canceled was low enrollment.
choices.B: The reason where the workshop was canceled was low enrollment.
choices.C: The reason when the workshop was canceled was low enrollment.
choices.D: The reason the workshop was canceled was low enrollment.

questions.translationJa: 研修会が中止された理由は申込者不足でした。
questions.explanationJa: 目的格のwhyは省略でき、the reason＋完全文が成立します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about formal conditions.

choices.A: The policy lists the conditions under where refunds may be granted.
choices.B: The policy lists the conditions which refunds may be granted under them.
choices.C: The policy lists the conditions under which refunds may be granted.
choices.D: The policy lists the conditions when refunds may be granted under.

questions.translationJa: 方針には返金が認められる条件が記載されています。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞underをwhichの前に置く正式な形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a past year.

choices.A: 2022 was the year where the company entered the Korean market.
choices.B: 2022 was the year when the company entered the Korean market.
choices.C: 2022 was the year when did the company enter the Korean market.
choices.D: 2022 was the year which the company entered the Korean market then.

questions.translationJa: 2022年は会社が韓国市場へ参入した年でした。
questions.explanationJa: yearという時をwhen節が説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an emergency room.

choices.A: The control room, when emergency calls are monitored, is staffed all night.
choices.B: The control room, where emergency calls are monitored there, is staffed all night.
choices.C: The control room, which emergency calls are monitored, is staffed all night.
choices.D: The control room, where emergency calls are monitored, is staffed all night.

questions.translationJa: 緊急通報を監視する管制室には終夜担当者がいます。
questions.explanationJa: 場所を補足するカンマ付きwhere節で、thereは不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: “The quarter when demand peaks begins in October.”

choices.A: Demand falls throughout the quarter beginning in October.
choices.B: October begins only after the busiest quarter ends.
choices.C: The company has not identified its busiest quarter.
choices.D: The quarter in which demand is highest begins in October.

questions.translationJa: 需要が最も高い四半期は10月に始まります。
questions.explanationJa: whenをin whichに替えて同じ時の関係を表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: “This is the desk where visitors register.”

choices.A: Visitors register this desk as company property.
choices.C: The desk registers every visitor automatically.
choices.D: Visitors may register only after the desk closes.

questions.translationJa: 来訪者はこの窓口で受付をします。
questions.explanationJa: whereはat this deskという場所情報に相当します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: “The reason why I called was to confirm the address.”

choices.A: I called after the address had been changed.
choices.B: I confirmed why the address made a call.
choices.C: I called because I wanted to confirm the address.
choices.D: The address was confirmed without any call.

questions.translationJa: 住所を確認するために電話しました。
questions.explanationJa: reason whyの内容をbecause節で言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: “We reached a point where further discussion was useless.”

choices.A: Further discussion became useless at that stage.
choices.B: We selected a physical point for the next discussion.
choices.C: The discussion became useful only after we left.
choices.D: No discussion had taken place before that point.

questions.translationJa: それ以上の議論が無意味になる段階に達しました。
questions.explanationJa: point whereは物理的位置でなく状況上の段階です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: “Friday is the day when the monthly report is issued.”

choices.A: The report covers only work completed on Friday.
choices.B: Friday is listed inside the monthly report.
choices.C: The report is canceled whenever Friday arrives.
choices.D: The monthly report is issued on Friday.

questions.translationJa: 月次報告書は金曜日に発行されます。
questions.explanationJa: when節をon Fridayという時の前置詞句にしています。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: “The warehouse in which the parts are stored is climate-controlled.”

choices.A: The parts control the climate inside the warehouse.
choices.B: The warehouse stores only climate-control equipment.
choices.C: The parts are stored in a climate-controlled warehouse.
choices.D: The parts are stored outside because the warehouse is closed.

questions.translationJa: 部品は空調管理された倉庫に保管されています。
questions.explanationJa: in whichの場所関係をin a warehouseで保っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: “I understand why the supplier changed the schedule.”

choices.A: I understand the reason the supplier changed the schedule.
choices.B: I understand when the supplier will keep the same schedule.
choices.C: The supplier changed the schedule without any reason.
choices.D: I asked the supplier where the schedule was stored.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先が日程を変更した理由を理解しています。
questions.explanationJa: why節はthe reason＋節に言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: “There are occasions when remote approval is permitted.”

choices.B: Remote approval is permitted on some occasions.
choices.C: Every occasion must be approved remotely.
choices.D: Approval is permitted only at a remote location.

questions.translationJa: 遠隔承認が認められる場合があります。
questions.explanationJa: whenはon some occasionsという時・場合を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: “The system creates an environment where teams can share files securely.”

choices.A: The system prevents teams from sharing any files.
choices.B: Teams must leave the environment before sharing files.
choices.C: The files create a separate system for every team.
choices.D: The system lets teams share files securely in that environment.

questions.translationJa: そのシステムはチームが安全にファイル共有できる環境を作ります。
questions.explanationJa: environment whereはその環境内での可能な動作を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: “The regulation specifies the cases in which an inspection is required.”

choices.A: The regulation requires an inspection in every case.
choices.B: The inspection explains why the regulation was removed.
choices.C: The regulation states which situations require an inspection.
choices.D: No situation covered by the regulation permits an inspection.

questions.translationJa: 規則は検査が必要になる事例を定めています。
questions.explanationJa: cases in whichをsituations that requireで意味を保っています。

questions.prompt: The board meeting has been moved to Tuesday. That is the day ------- all regional directors will be in Tokyo.

choices.C: why
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 取締役会は火曜日へ変更されました。全地域責任者が東京にいる日です。
questions.explanationJa: dayという時を説明するためwhenです。

questions.prompt: The service failed during checkout. Engineers are investigating the point ------- the payment data stopped transferring.

choices.C: where
choices.D: whom

questions.translationJa: 決済中にサービスが停止しました。支払データの転送が止まった段階を調査中です。
questions.explanationJa: pointを工程上の状況として受けるwhereです。

questions.prompt: Your request was declined because one form was missing. That is the reason ------- we need a new submission.

choices.C: when
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 書類不足で依頼が却下されました。そのため再提出が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: reasonの内容を示すwhyが文脈に合います。

questions.prompt: The records are kept in a restricted area. Only managers may enter the room ------- they are stored.

choices.C: why
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 記録は制限区域に保管されています。その保管室へは管理職だけが入れます。
questions.explanationJa: storedの場所を示すwhereを使います。

questions.prompt: Please review the warranty terms. Section 8 describes the conditions ------- replacement parts are provided free of charge.

choices.C: under which
choices.D: of which

questions.translationJa: 保証条件を確認してください。第8条に交換部品を無償提供する条件があります。
questions.explanationJa: 条件の下で、を表す正式なunder whichです。

questions.prompt: The conference was held in June. It was a period ------- hotel rates were unusually high.

choices.C: who
choices.D: when

questions.translationJa: 会議は6月に開かれました。ホテル料金が異例に高い時期でした。
questions.explanationJa: periodという時の背景をwhenが補います。

questions.prompt: The client asked for a private area ------- the prototype could be demonstrated safely.

choices.C: why
choices.D: whose

questions.translationJa: 顧客は試作品を安全に実演できる専用区域を求めました。
questions.explanationJa: demonstratedの場所が欠けるためwhereです。

questions.prompt: We have not renewed the lease. The main reason ------- is that the building lacks backup power.

choices.C: when
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 賃貸契約は更新していません。主な理由は建物に予備電源がないことです。
questions.explanationJa: the main reason whyのwhyが後続の空所を受けます。

questions.prompt: The revised procedure covers incidents ------- customer data may have been exposed. Report such cases immediately.

choices.C: with which
choices.D: by which

questions.translationJa: 改訂手順は顧客データが漏えいした可能性のある事案を対象にします。
questions.explanationJa: incidentsの中で起きる状況を形式的にin whichで結びます。

questions.prompt: Next Monday marks ten years since our first export. It is the anniversary ------- the sales team will announce a new target.

choices.C: why
choices.D: whom

questions.translationJa: 次の月曜で初輸出から10年です。その記念日に営業部が新目標を発表します。
questions.explanationJa: anniversaryという時点をwhen節が説明します。
